chapter.verse: Tua ciangin a thahat vanmi dang khat meiilom tawh kituamin vantung pan hong pai ka mu hi. A lutang tungsan teng ah sakhi-tuihup khat om a, a maitang ni tawh kibangin a khete meikuang khuampi tawh kibang hi.
A khut sungah laihualno a kizalsa khat tawi hi. Tuipi tungah a taklam khe nga-in leitang tungah a veilam khe a ngak khit ciangin
humpi hawk bangin awging lianpi tawh kiko hi. A kiko ciangin kek sagihte ging uh hi.
Kek sagihte a gin khit ciangin lai gelh dingin ka kithawi leh vantung pan awging khat ka za a, “Kek sagihte' genkhiat teng ciaptehna gipa belh inla tuate gelhkhia kei in,” hong ci hi.
Tua ciangin tuipi tung leh leitang tungah a ding vanmi ka muh pen in vantung lamah a taklam khut laamto-in

vantung leh a sunga omte, leitung leh a sunga omte leh tuipi leh a sunga omte, tuate a piangsak ahi, a tawntung a tawntunga a nungtapa' min tawh kiciam hi. A kiciam thu pen hun sottoh om nawnlo ding, cih thu leh
vanmi sagihte' pengkul hong gin ding hunlenite hong tun ciangin ama' sila kamsangte' tungah a kitangkosa bangin Pasian' thusim hong tangtung ding, cih thu ahi hi.
Tua ciangin vantung pana awging ka zak pen in kei hong hopih leuleu a, “Pai inla tuipi tung leh leitang tunga a ding vanmi' khut sunga om laihual kizalsa va la in,” hong ci hi.

Kei zong vanmi' kiangah va pai-in laihualno hong piak nading ka gen hi. Tua ciangin amah in, “La inla ne in. Tua in na gil hong khasak ding a, ahi zongin na kam sungah khuaizu bangin khum ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Kei zong vanmi' khut sungpan laihualno la-in ka ne hi. Khuaizu bangin khum a, ahi zongin ka nek khit ciangin tua in ka gil khasak hi.
Tua ciangin kei' kiangah, “Tualmi, khualmi, kampau, kumpi a tampite tawh kisai-in kamsanna na nei ding hi,” hong kici hi.
